source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘዚአሆሙ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ አርአየከ፡ እሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ አስማቲሆሙ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወየአምኑ፡ በስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።

translation.text: And he said to me, “The Lord of spirits[a] has shown you their likeness. These are their names—the names of the holy ones who dwell on dry land and believe in the name of the Lord of spirits forever and ever.”

footnotes.text: The selected edition prints መንፈስት in both occurrences of the title. Its apparatus27 gives መንፈሳት as the reading of other manuscripts. The selected printed spelling is retained in the source, not silently replaced with that alternative or another familiar plural.
